## SimpleGrid.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `columns` :: Fixed column count when `minChildWidth` is omitted.
- `minChildWidth` :: Minimum width per track for fluid responsive `auto-fit` wrapping (e.g. `'14rem'`).
- `gap` :: Gap between grid tracks on the shared gap ladder.
- `children` :: The items to lay out, one per grid track.
